name: Ring of the Hesitant Climber, Improved
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

As a ring of the hesitant climber except the Will save is DC 20 to avoid becoming panicked.

This ring can be removed freely.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of climbing, improved

Identification DC 30
False Identification DC 20
